title: Pharmacist Quick Reference — Immunization Services Outside Entries Without a Lot Number
content:
**Immunization Services — posted doses counted from positions.** Where the number is counted from positions, cash-paid entries recorded from another provider without a lot number hold positions as follows: 0 positions each where a documented cash-paid outside entry is on the course, 1 position between them where none is and Kestrel reported a dose of the course, and one each otherwise.

| Read on the course history | Positions held by the cash-paid outside entries without a lot number |
|---|---|
| A documented cash-paid outside entry (cash-paid, names no Kestrel store, carries a lot number) is on the course | 0 each |
| No documented cash-paid outside entry, and a Kestrel report of a dose of the course to the state registry is on it | 1 between them, however many there are (none where there are none) |
| No documented cash-paid outside entry, and no Kestrel registry report | 1 each |

**Reading the chart.** The rows are taken in order and the first that fits decides. An entry "recorded from another provider" names no Kestrel store; "without a lot number" means the entry's lot number is empty.

**Hypothetical checks.**

- Two undocumented entries, one documented cash-paid outside entry, Kestrel report present: 0 positions.
- Three undocumented entries, no documented entry, Kestrel report present: 1 position.
- Three undocumented entries, no documented entry, no Kestrel report: 3 positions.
- One undocumented entry, no documented entry, Kestrel report present: 1 position.
